one_liner: Unified spend platform with global corporate cards, expense management, reimbursements, travel, and bill pay with REST API and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server support.
access_notes: Brex customers can generate API tokens directly in their Brex dashboard or use self-serve developer access.
verdict_reason: Brex provides documented REST APIs, OpenAPI specifications, and self-serve developer token generation alongside an official MCP server.

evidence.snippet: Our APIs use OAuth for authentication and authorization.
As a Brex customer, you can generate API tokens in your Brex dashboard to make API calls for your own account
Brex APIs use the REST architecture, are defined using the OpenAPI specification
Brex hosts an official MCP server at https://api.brex.com/mcp, in beta
